name: Siansa Beats (dev)
author: Siansa
description: For Siansa Dev, an experiment: the Siansa plugin's loudness and fades with each song's tempo, beats, bars and phrases from Siansa Beats (Beat This!). Installs next to the Siansa plugin and reads what it measured; measures nothing itself.

versions.changelog: First version: profiles from the Siansa plugin's measurements with the beat grids from Siansa Beats.
